polityNote: First-level divisions of Georgia from the dissolution of the USSR to the eve of the last of the nine regions (mkhare). Judgement on the level: a region is the jurisdiction of a presidential State Trustee (governor), and the posts were instituted one region at a time — Kakheti 4 Oct 1993, Samtskhe-Javakheti 31 Jul 1994, Kvemo Kartli 29 Aug 1994, Imereti 26 Jan 1995, Guria 22 Feb 1995, Shida Kartli 6 Mar 1995, Mtskheta-Mtianeti 19 Mar 1995, Racha-Lechkhumi-Kvemo Svaneti 12 May 1995, Samegrelo-Zemo Svaneti 19 Dec 1995 (decrees cited by date and number in presidential decree No. 363 of 8 Jun 1999, matsne 1257125, which repealed them). From its trustee’s institution a region is taken as the first-level unit, because the trustee directed and could suspend the raion and city administrations beneath him (decree No. 318 of 2004 states the power); before it, the first level was the raions and the cities of republican subordination, beside the autonomous republics of Abkhazia and Adjara (the South Ossetian AO was abolished on 11 Dec 1990). US BGN (CIA Factbook 1992–96: only the 2 ARs, rayons under direct republic jurisdiction; 1997–2001: 53 rayons, 9 cities, 2 ARs; regions from the 2002 edition) and ISO 3166-2 (raions until Newsletter I-2 of 21 May 2002) kept listing the raions; statoids.com notes ISO/DIS 1996 already mentioned unnamed prefectures, so this is a lag of the catalogues, not a different administration. Consequence for data/hist-admin-fill.js, which draws twelve units from 1995-01-01: on that date three regions existed; the twelve-unit structure was complete on 1995-12-19. Atoms: geoBoundaries GEO ADM1 (2015, Wikimedia, 12 units). The ADM2 set (manifest 2007, 68 municipalities) was measured and rejected: against OpenStreetMap its municipalities agree at IoU 0.42–0.77 and it folds the republican cities into raions. Check ① (2026-10-06, geodesic, against OpenStreetMap relations whose areas match published figures within 1% — Adjara 2,897 vs 2,880, Guria 2,032 vs 2,033, Tbilisi 504 vs 504.3): the Abkhazia atom is 8,643 km² vs OSM 8,647, IoU 0.974 overall and 0.988 inland (both clipped to the common outline); against the OpenHistoricalMap Abkhaz ASSR in force on 1992-01-01 (0.05° grid) it lies 0.990 inside it, IoU 0.896, OHM’s outline taking in sea; the other atoms are inland IoU 0.91–0.985 and Tbilisi 0.48, so only Abkhazia is drawn, and only while the republic was under Georgian administration (to the outbreak of war, 14 Aug 1992; OpenHistoricalMap draws the Abkhaz ASSR to 23 Jul 1992 and answers that part). cshapes keeps Abkhazia and South Ossetia inside Georgia throughout; this dossier separates them by administration.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Administrative divisions of Georgia (country)
sources.says: Regions were set up by presidential decrees 1994–1996 on a provisional basis and are not self-governing; the autonomous republics Abkhazia and Adjara date from the Soviet era; South Ossetian autonomy was abolished in December 1990.

sources.title: CIA World Factbook 1992 (Project Gutenberg 48) — Georgia, Administrative divisions
sources.says: 2 autonomous republics (Abkhazia, Ajaria); no oblasts, the rayons are under direct republic jurisdiction; the South Ossetia Autonomous Oblast is also mentioned.

sources.title: Wikipedia — War in Abkhazia (1992–1993)
sources.says: The war lasted from 14 August 1992 to 30 September 1993; Abkhazia became de facto independent and Georgia kept only the upper Kodori Valley.

spans.dateNote: Begins at the scope: the Abkhaz ASSR of the Georgian SSR continued as an autonomous republic of Georgia. Ends at the outbreak of war on 14 Aug 1992, after which the republic was cut by front lines (see unresolved).

unresolved.what: Abkhazia during the war
unresolved.why: From 14 Aug 1992 the republic was cut by front lines: Gudauta district never came under Georgian forces, Gagra was lost in early October 1992, Tkvarcheli was an Abkhaz-held enclave inside Ochamchire district, and the front ran along the Gumista inside Sukhumi district. One atom covers the whole republic, so the part under Georgian administration cannot be drawn.
